purpose: Put the two rules the r9 review fixed into the code -- when the re-read of the Gaussian judgment falls on the iteration of the opacity reset it comes first and the reset reads the protection it has just set; the part of an LoD2 wall that overlaps a wall of another building is left out of the prior surface -- and make three checks: the mesh check of invisible faces in two layers (mechanism: only the aimed Gaussians; product: the whole scene), the initial direction of airborne LiDAR prior Gaussians by two methods (vertex: area-weighted normal of the incident triangles, r9; cell: the face normal of the cell the point first sits in), and whether r9's worse ground-truth column of case 3 in airborne LiDAR nominal is run-to-run spread or the share of the initial-direction fix. No claim about the method's effect; no baseline, no multi-building evaluation.
parent_tasks: PHD-STAGE2-R9-THREE-FIXES-v1 (fork r9, shared module v3, stage-1 products, trainings)
method_document: 2026-10-02 version with the r9 review (body rev 854; sections 3.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.6 transcribed in the appendix of the order; bold = changed since r9)
shared_module: src/phd/prior_propagation_v4 = v3 + faces.party_wall_overlaps / cut_triangles (the party-wall cut) + locations.build_plane_store option 'o' (grid origin); the other seven files byte-identical to v3. The fork r10 keeps importing v3 (it uses none of the changed functions)

code_names.J_loc: 패치의 판정 (patch judgment; was '전파된 판정' as the Gaussian's state in r8 wording)

fixes.ga: re-read before the opacity reset when both fall on one iteration (method 4.2, 4.6). r9 already does this: the re-read runs at the start of the iteration (train.py update_E before the render), the reset at its end (after the step and the density control) with exempt_mask = the protection the re-read set. No code change; recorded in the comparison table. Added: a record-only wrapper around reset_opacity that dumps the state right before and right after the reset (--jbgs_reset_dump_iterations), and an offline probe (--jbgs_dry_init 3) that re-reads both states with the r9 re-read function
fixes.na: LoD2 party walls: the part of a wall polygon that overlaps a wall polygon of another building (outward normals opposite, cosine <= -0.9; on their common plane the polygons intersect where the planes lie within 0.1 m) is cut from both walls in stage 1 (render, residuals, tolerance, surface numbers, marks, patches) and stage 2 (sampling, planting): the r9 sample without the points on the cut parts, the r9 prior depth with only the rays that hit a cut part re-rendered. Airborne LiDAR unchanged

checks.da: mesh check in two layers: mechanism = TSDF of the depth of the added views rendered with only the aimed Gaussians; product = r9's TSDF of the training + added views with the whole scene. Same values in both: share of the aimed Gaussians within 0.25 m of the mesh (per face), mesh -> prior distance (median, 95 %); occluders per added view by origin and size; spread from the repeated runs
checks.ra: initial direction of airborne LiDAR prior Gaussians: vertex (r9: area-weighted normal of the incident triangles of the seat surface) against cell (the face normal t1 x t2 of the cell the point first sits in = the face u_i is measured on; points without a patch keep the vertex normal). Sign up, angle about the normal, scale, opacity, colour as r9
checks.ma: case 3 ground-truth column (|result - GT| median, share within tau of GT) of the existing r8, r8 repeat, r9, r9 without fix 'da' trainings (airborne LiDAR nominal and LoD2 nominal) with r9's definitions, and of the r10 airborne LiDAR trainings

tolerance.rule: tau = 2.5 x NMAD after one clip at 3 NMAD, per prior and surface kind; the agency spec is never a lower bound, it is recorded with its source and compared; tau > spec leaves a warning

spec_source.L_roof: TUM2TWIN: Bavarian ALS vertical accuracy 0.12 m (configs/phd/stage1_conf_tol_conflict_v1/experiment.json)
spec_source.M_roof: LoD2 height accuracy about 1 m (same file)
spec_source.walls: no agency wall accuracy in the data (recorded as 'no spec')

tolerance.pool: nominal scene, 15 views, A = 1, building faces of the target building DEBY_LOD2_4959323 (LoD2 roof and wall polygons of that building -- the bottom face and the overlapping parts of party walls are no longer prior faces; TIN building surfaces inside its LoD2 GroundSurface outline, as r8)
tolerance.registration: unchanged (L +0.0186 m, M +0.1216 m, estimated on inclined roof faces in stage 1 v2)

marks.rule: every prior pixel with A = 1: |MVS - prior| x f <= tau -> agree, else conflict; tau of the pixel's surface kind on building faces, the roof tau on pixels that are not building faces (TIN ground, steep triangles); the per-pixel map is a stage-1 product (markmap/)

surfaces.tin_outline_main: LoD2 GroundSurface polygons (given outline; as r7)
surfaces.tin_building_surface_main: majority of the surface's vertices carry class 6 (as r7)
surfaces.tin_outline_second_source: decision 4: the classification decides building against non-building only (a triangle is a building triangle when >= 2 of its vertices carry class 6); buildings are split by steep triangles; non-building and steep triangles carry no number. Built for the pre-measurement comparison (variant cls2)
surfaces.lod2_untyped_rule: normal n_z <= -0.5 and the face's highest vertex within 0.1 m of its building's lowest vertex (cross-check only: this scene has types)
surfaces.party_wall_rule: r10 (cut): wall polygons (CityGML WallSurface) of different buildings with outward normals of cosine <= -0.9; the overlap = intersection of their projections on the common plane (n_c = (n_a - n_b)/|n_a - n_b|, origin the midpoint of the centroids, first axis horizontal) inside the strip where the two planes lie within 0.1 m along n_c; cut from both walls; overlaps or remaining pieces below 1e-6 m2 ignored. r9 (count only, kept for the comparison): a wall cell within 0.1 m of a wall triangle of another building with opposite normal
surfaces.party_wall_frame: a cut polygon keeps the grid origin and the plane normal of its r9 polygon (the plane is not changed by the cut), so its remaining cells are the r9 cells

locations.views: 13 training views of r5/r6/r7 (test views 0002 and 0016 excluded)
locations.view_mark: a supporting view marks the unit agree when its agree pixels >= its conflict pixels (implementation choice, as r7)

prior_weight: g_p = 0 where the pixel's unit is judged conflict (support vote or propagated, alike); 1 where agree / mixed / insufficient; pixel without a unit: 1 where A = 0, own mark where A = 1. Decided once at initialisation; the MVS term keeps c_p = A
initialisation: plant every prior point except those of missing units with a propagated conflict; support units regardless of their vote, invisible units and points without a unit are planted; r9: points on LoD2 bottom faces, r10: points on the cut parts of party walls are not in the prior sample; prior-origin Gaussians oriented with the face (fix da)
prior_render: r10 LoD2 prior depth = the r9 prior depth except at the rays that hit a cut part of a party wall in r9: there the render of the r10 mesh (same LoD2Depth ray setup and crop). Triangle ids renumbered to the r10 mesh
gaussian_confidence: unit: its E (product at initialisation; 3 x 3 cell samples with the current render as one-sided occluder every 500 iterations). No unit: share of the views seeing the centre (one-sided) whose centre pixel has A = 1 (prior depth as occluder at initialisation, the render later). No seeing view: 0
protection: prior origin & patch judgment != conflict & E < 0.5 & u <= 4 tau (rule.protected); u as r8 (vertical over the initial patch's surface on roof-like, along its normal on wall-like, vertical without a patch; tau of that surface kind, roof tau without a patch)

training.schedule: as the last training experiment (PHD-STAGE2-R6-FIX-v1): 3,500 iterations, seed 0 (safe_state), 13 training views + 2 test views at 1600 x 1157, base GeoGS/2DGS settings unchanged (densify 500-15,000 every 100, opacity reset every 3,000, normal consistency from 7,000 i.e. not reached, depth distortion weight 0)

M_N_nodepth.meaning: LoD2 nominal, prior depth term off

L_N_vertex.meaning: airborne LiDAR nominal, vertex method (r9 code apart from the record-only dumps)
L_N_vertex.use: r9 again if the order was already right

L_N_cell_rep.meaning: airborne LiDAR nominal, cell method again

L_B_vertex.meaning: airborne LiDAR main roof +1 m, vertex method

L_B_cell.meaning: airborne LiDAR main roof +1 m, cell method

extra_dumps.why: the state before and after the opacity reset at 3,000 (r9 table ra-3) and the two reset states of 2-1

reset_dumps.what: record-only wrapper around reset_opacity: the Gaussian parameters, origin, init_id, protection and the judgment rows right before the reset (after the step and the density control of that iteration) and right after it (before the next update)

probe: offline re-read of the two reset states (--jbgs_dry_init 3): the fork is initialised as for training (same inputs, same command), the dumped state is loaded into the model and update_E_r8 (the r9 re-read function) runs on it; per (patch, training view) the seeing decision of seat.reread_E with that one view, per (Gaussian without a patch, view) the one of seat.centre_E

mesh.rule: TSDF of the rendered expected depth of the 13 training views plus virtual views that look at the Gaussians no training view sees (the base implementation's create_virtual_cameras_for_completion, rings of 8 cameras at elevations 0.2 and 0.5, distance 1.5 x 2 x region radius), Open3D ScalableTSDFVolume via GaussianExtractor.extract_mesh_bounded. The region the views aim at = invisible prior Gaussians (opacity >= 0.5) on outward faces of the target building (aiming at every invisible prior Gaussian of the crop put the ring 200 m away at a low elevation; the LoD2 bottom face lies inside the walls and is reported, not aimed at)
mesh.voxel_note: 0.05 m (sdf_trunc 0.25 m) ran out of host memory (more than 43 GB for one run) once the added views were aimed at the target building; 0.10 m with the base ratio sdf_trunc = 5 x voxel
mesh.box: fusion bounded to the crop rectangle of the stage-1 products (als_crop_local_xy) + box_margin_m and z in box_z_m: pixels whose rendered point lies outside get depth 0 through the base implementation's background mask (gt_alpha_mask); without it the fusion at 5 cm voxels ran out of memory on Gaussians that drifted hundreds of metres away
mesh.invisible_definition: no training view sees the Gaussian's centre with the final render as the one-sided occluder (depth tolerance 0.5 m, accumulated opacity < 0.05 occludes nothing)
mesh.r8_views: the r9 scene is also rendered from r8's virtual cameras (rebuilt from r8's aimed Gaussians) for side-by-side figures
mesh.mesh_to_prior: mesh vertices within 0.5 m of an aimed Gaussian's initial position -> distance to the prior surface (median, 95 %)

layers.product: r9's TSDF: rendered expected depth of the 13 training views + the added views, whole scene
layers.mechanism: TSDF of the added views only, rendered with only the aimed Gaussians

mesh.occluders: per added view: an aimed Gaussian is hidden when its centre lies more than 0.5 m behind the rendered expected depth (accumulated opacity >= 0.05) of the whole scene; an occluder of it = a Gaussian that is not aimed, has opacity >= 0.05, lies more than 0.5 m in front of it and whose projected centre is within its screen radius (rasterizer radii) of the hidden Gaussian's pixel. Occluders counted by group: image origin, scale above 1 m, prior origin of other buildings, protected (groups overlap)
mesh.figure_cameras: r8's virtual cameras 3 and 11 (r9 report: 3 = r9 figure, 11 = r8 figure), rebuilt from r8's aimed Gaussians

analysis.angle: angle between a Gaussian's disk normal and its prior face normal, unsigned (a disk has two sides): arccos |n_g . n_f|; the sign is checked at initialisation
analysis.ra_depth_change: training pixels whose LoD2 face is a target roof or wall (maps/faceid, faces.json); |D_after - D_3000| at 3,001 and 3,050
analysis.gt: gt_clean depth maps of the stage-2 inputs (the evaluation point cloud of the GeoGS example scene, z-buffered per view, points hidden behind a nearer one dropped, shifted -7.46 cm to the photo ground level; user-approved 2026-09-25); case 3 pixels: prior pixels with c_p = 0 on missing patches, by propagated judgment; tau = the pixel's tolerance in metres
